description: The agent, which runs as root, follows symlinks when it creates files and directories at configured paths.

provenance.construction: reverse of 0fdf8e411d: the new side of the diff is the code before the change; 11 explanatory line(s) deleted from the old side were dropped so the diff does not explain the fix

expected.rationale: With no O_NOFOLLOW on the final path component and no refusal of symlinked directory components, a local user can plant a symlink and make the agent create, truncate or chown files elsewhere. The fix added all three protections; they are removed here. GitHub rated the advisory high.

issues.description: The file is opened without O_NOFOLLOW, so a symlink at the final path component is followed by a process running as root.
Ancestor directories are examined with os.Stat, which follows symlinks, instead of os.Lstat.
A symlinked path component is no longer rejected before the code treats it as a directory.
